instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text rendered in the user interface is strictly in SPANISH (e.g. 'Estado del Acta', 'Centro de Cómputo', 'Mesa de Sufragio', 'Desbloquear con Justificación').
Implement the client-side compression simulation for uploaded actas photos along with an interactive canvas/zoom container on the left column.
Implement OCR text extraction preview overlay highlighting candidate values with confidence percentages.
Ensure input validation checks if (Votos Válidos + Blancos + Nulos) matches Total Papeletas Registradas and highlights discrepancies in red.
Ensure every form field, button, status badge, modal and table row contains explicit data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
